en.description: Turn authorized blackboard photos and teacher-supplied facts into one blackboard one-shot clip per photo. This one-shot blackboard studio makes a silent 2-15s blackboard clip from each board photo clip. Use it for classroom blackboard video and lesson-board clip sets that stay one photo one clip.
